reason: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:423-468, the recurring series-delete block (lines 444-468) sits inside `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` (line 423) without referencing `reference` or the looked-up `calendarCredential`/`calendar` (lines 428-443). Instead, on every iteration it iterates only `bookingToDelete.user.credentials` (lines 449-450) and selects only the first calendar reference via `updBooking.references.find(...)` (line 454), causing N duplicate deletion passes for the first reference while never deleting other hosts' calendar copies.
